title: Quiz Studio Review Request
description: A self-contained transport envelope handing a finalized Learner Response to an external human/AI/agent reviewer and asking for a canonical Teacher Review back. This is an export/transport artifact, not a canonical learning record; the canonical record is the embedded learnerResponse.

learnerResponse.description: A faithful portable copy of the canonical quiz-studio.learner-response contract. Validate it against learner-response.schema.json and the runtime validateLearnerResponse() boundary.
